translation.name: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002
translation.englishName: Yombe: Biblica® Open Nkanda wu Moyo, Nguizani Yimona ayi Minkunga 2002 (Bible)

content.text: Wungwa, a Nzambi, bu ndilembo wakikisa maniongo mama
keba luzingu luama va ntuala mbeni yoyi
ndieti mona tsisi !
Wutsueka mu zikhanu zintotukilanga
mu lukutukunu lu nsueki lu batu bambimbi
ayi mu lukutukunu lu nkangu wu batu bamvanganga mambimbi ;
bobo badi bulawu.
Balembo bengula ludimi luawu banga sabala ;
bantotulanga mambu mawu banga madionga meti vonda.
Beti lozila bu badi mu bibuangu bisuama
mutu kambulu zaba diambu
Beti kunlozila mu kinzimbukila, mu kambu mona tsisi.
Beti kukikindisa mu zikhanu zimbimbi ;
beti tubana mu diambu di batamba mintambu miawu,
Beti kamba : “A nani wela mimona e ?”
Beti yindula mambu makambulu masonga ayi beti tuba :
“Tukubikidi lukanu lu fuana.”
Bukiedika, mayindu ma tsi ntima
ayi ntima wu mutu thipula bidi.
Vayi Nzambi wela kuba lozila madionga mandi
mu kinzimbukila bela.
Wela balula ludimi luawu veka mu diambu diawu
ayi kuba nata ku mbivusu
babo bela kuba mona bela nikuna ntu.
Batu boso bela mona tsisi,
bela yamikisa mavanga ma Nzambi ;
ayi bela sudika momo kavanga.
Bika mutu wusonga kamona khini mu Yave
ayi katombila suamunu mu niandi
ayi babo badi mintima mi lulama banzitisa.
